title: two faces · each incomplete · merge (burning man)
concept: Each face is broken alone — six random spherical holes are cut from the merged head pose, and particles fall into one of two heads based on whether their position is INSIDE or OUTSIDE the hole regions. Head A gets non-hole particles; Head B gets the complementary in-hole particles. Apart, each is visibly broken. Together (uMix=1), the two clouds occupy exactly the same head and complete each other. The Burning Man emotional payload: incomplete people seeking completion in each other.
notes: Direct response to user feedback: 'w64 directionally interesting (could push it in burning man direction where 2 person facing each other each incomplete merges)'. Two heads sit at x=±5, both face-forward (same orientation as merged pose); merge is pure X-axis translation toward x=0. Earlier draft rotated heads ±90° around Y so they faced each other in profile, but the un-rotation during merge read as a Y-axis sweep — dropped per user feedback 2026-05-06. Auto-oscillation is asymmetric: 7s apart, 4s merged-target (mix peaks briefly, no long plateau). Click toggles target. Warm bone (head A) ↔ cool steel (head B) duotone, both drifting toward shared cream at merge. The morph is a single per-particle lerp.
